11:111.text: - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Aware of what they do.

11:112.text: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded,
and those who have turned back with you
, and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.

11:113.text: And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allāh any protectors; then you would not be helped.

11:114.text: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.

11:115.text: And be patient, for indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

11:116.text: among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals.

11:117.text: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
